lead: Prithviraj Kapoor was a politician, born on 3 November 1906 in Faisalabad.
He died on 29 May 1972 in Mumbai at the age of 65.
He has 35 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
This profile collects the Prithviraj facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Prithviraj Kapoor — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Prithviraj Kapoor was born on 3 November 1906 in Faisalabad, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name his father, Basheshwarnath Kapoor. He is a sibling of Trilok Kapoor.
He received his education at Edwardes College Peshawar and Lyallpur Khalsa College.

sections.heading: Prithviraj Kapoor — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, stage actor, film actor, film director, film producer and theatre manager as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (1952–1960).
